title: Travis Scott, Charli xcx, The Killers and David Guetta to Headline 2027 Lollapalooza Argentina, Brazil & Chile
summary: Queens of the Stone Age and the Neighbourhood will also take the main stage at the three festivals scheduled for March of next year.
contentText:
Lollapalooza Chile, Argentina and Brazil announced their lineups for the 2027 editions of the festivals on Thursday morning (Oct. 8), with Travis Scott, Charli xcx, The Killers, David Guetta, Queens of the Stone Age and The Neighbourhood slated to headline each edition.

Lollapalooza Chile will take place at Parque O’Higgins in Santiago from March 12-14 with a lineup that will also feature Rawayana, Fontaines D.C., Sombr, The Prodigy, Malcolm Todd, Dominic Fike, Cage the Elephant, Geese, Raye, Slayyyter, Lola Young, Adéla, Four Tet, Leon Bridges and more.

Lollapalooza Argentina will set up at Hippodromo de San Isidro in Buenos Aires from March 12-14 with a similar lineup of headliners, along with sets from Tini, Dillom, Un Poco De Ruido, Marlon Hoffstadt, Angine De Poitrine, Tomora, K4OS, Usted Señalemelo, Boyz Noize, Snow Strippers and more.

Lolla Brazil at the Autódromo de Interlagos in São Paulo will run from March 19-21 — marking the 15th anniversary of the Brazilian edition — again, with similar headliners and main stage acts, as well as Mochakk, Rodrigo Amarante, Mike D 5D, Sammy Virji, Julia Wolf, Ninajirachi, Criolo, Amaro E Dino, Die Spitz, Cat Dealers, the Avalanches and Violet Grohl, and many more.

Tickets for all three are available now.

Last year’s events were headlined by Sabrina Carpenter, Tyler, the Creator, Chappell Roan, the Deftones, Lorde, Skrillex, Doechii, Turnstile, Lewis Capaldi, Interpol, Peggy Gou, Kygo, Addison Rae, Tom Morello, Paulo Londra and Danny Ocean, among others.
